title: Sync Sketchpad Design Hover Between Diagram and Scene Windows
description: Make design-app hover use a single canonical source so diagram and scene windows stay synchronized. Fix the current non-visible hover regression and validate the shared hover flow.
summary: Unified design-app hover around the actor-backed hover state so diagram and scene windows stay synchronized. HoverPiecesProvider now reads actor hover directly, diagram render-data sync consumes raw hover snapshots, and the embedded Design regression verifies both actor-driven and diagram-driven hover updates.
